author: Nerdstalgic
description:
Despite noble intentions and a clear reverence for the character, Superman Returns struggled to gain momentum. While Brandon Routh’s performance captured the spirit of Christopher Reeve’s Superman, the film’s slow pacing, muted conflict, and cautious storytelling prevented it from truly taking flight.

title: Every Reason Why Superman Returns Didn’t Work
